empty.title: Bring an idea. It will be questioned, not praised.
empty.lead: hypar helps you find out whether an idea is worth keeping. Nothing is deleted: every idea ends somewhere you can come back to.

seed.body: Write the idea in your own words, rough is fine.

challenge.body: An agent asks one hard question at a time. You answer, or change the idea.

outcome.body: When it holds up or falls apart, you close it and say why.

fossil.name: Fossil
fossil.body: set aside for good, with the reason you gave. It stays readable.

transplanted.name: Transplanted
transplanted.body: it worked: you moved it into the world and note what came of it.

empty.cta: Plant your first seed in the box above

challenge.germinateHint: The seed has met its first challenge
